profile.summary: TriMark R.W. Smith is a foodservice equipment and supplies distributor based in San Diego, California. It sells equipment, tabletop items and supplies to commercial kitchens, including hotels, restaurants, corporate and academic dining facilities, and healthcare operations. It is part of TriMark USA, a national foodservice design, equipment and supplies company.
